action.objective: Commit Bd3, developing the bishop to a strong diagonal after ...a6.
action.rationale: Bd3 is the only commit_ready move. Broad depth-2 search ranked it top (47, exact), and single-candidate verification at depth 4 completed with score 3, PV Bd3 Nc6 Nxc6 Bxc6. Safety is complete: no immediate mate, no checking-reply refutation found, no forced mate against White. The bishop retreats from a6-b5 pressure to a solid central diagonal, keeping the knight on e5 and preparing kingside castling. Analysis nodes are exhausted, so I commit the verified move.
